title: <repo>/.agentic-workflow/commands.json
description: A repo's command catalog (#4221): the helpers an agent should find and reuse before it writes a new one. Each entry points at an entrypoint that exists in the repo or on PATH; the catalog never copies a helper's body. The toolkit ships its own catalog of the same shape (config/commands.toolkit.json). Rules a schema can't state (a duplicate id, a {param} slot no param declares, an owner-home path, a repo path that does not exist) are checked by `aw-commands validate`.

id.description: Unique in its catalog; what `aw-commands show <id>` takes.

purpose.description: One sentence: what it is for. Searched.

argv.description: The command as separate arguments, never one string for a shell. argv[0] is a command on PATH or a repo-relative path. {name} fills in a declared param.

cwd.description: repo: run from the repo's top level; any: run from anywhere.

prerequisites.description: What must exist first (a tool on PATH, a running service, a login).

output.description: What it prints and its exit codes.

stop.description: When it ends and what it cleans up; how to stop it early.
